proof.rationale: Added a safe carve-out for recurring no-PO services that show a consistent billing pattern (duplicate_score > 0.2) to auto-approve them, while keeping all other no-PO bills on hold per the safety rule. Also introduced two independent signals—comparing billed amounts against both received goods and the PO—to distinguish legitimate price increases from short shipments or unauthorized over-billing before escalating.
